newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CANTV tariff hike approval seen soon.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CANTV tariff hike approval seen soon.

text.p: Venezuelan Transport and Communications Minister Moises Orozco said Tuesday that the government this month expects to approve the amount of phone company CANTV's scheduled third quarter tariff increases.
CANTV has asked for an average 1.98 percent tariff rise for the quarter running July 1 to September 30 after receiving an average 4.18 percent increase on April 14.
"We hope to have it (the amount of the increase) ready within two weeks ...The analysis required to establish the company's cost structure is very complex," Orozco told reporters in Congress.

Orozco added the Ministry was simultaneously reviewing the tariff adjustment formula for future rises. The original 1991 contract between CANTV and the government allows for revisions in the rate setting system in the third, sixth and eighth years of the concession.
